name: shipgate
description: Policy-controlled Git commits and pushes for coding agents, with credential scanning and undo.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @shipgate/core && npm run build -w @shipgate/cli && npm run build -w @shipgate/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @shipgate/core && npm run test -w @shipgate/core && npm run test -w @shipgate/cli && npm run test -w @shipgate/web && npm run build -w @shipgate/web
